",
"",
""];
const b=Uint8Array.from(atob(p.join("")),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
const s=new Response(b).body.pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"));
const h=await new Response(s).text();
document.open();document.write(h);document.close();
}catch(e){document.getElementById("m").textContent="Load error: "+e}
})();
